From 1 October, eligible customers can earn and use ComBank Yellow Points, giving them more choice and flexibility in how they're rewarded.
At the heart of this change is a new approach to rewards, recognizing customers not just for transactions, but for their broader relationship with the bank.
Customers can earn points in more ways than ever before.
This includes taking out eligible products, renewing existing ones, reaching banking milestones and making eligible card purchases.

Customers who currently earn points through a ComBank Awards credit card will transition to earning ComBank Yellow points, while also gaining access to the broader range of benefits available through ComBank Yellow.
Customers can also earn points when shopping with participating brand digital stores available through the ComBank Yellow Hub.
In addition, customers can boost their points balance by activating eligible bonus points offers in the CommBank app.
Once customers have earned points, they can choose how to use them across travel, shopping, gift cards, everyday essentials, and more through the new Redemption Portal.
Customers can also transfer their points to participating loyalty programs, giving them even more ways to be rewarded.
In addition to points, customers will continue to enjoy exclusive offers, discounts, and pre-sale access through ComBank Yellow.
